thread.title: Apple is investigating an iPhone X glitch which has stopped some people from answering calls (AAPL)

author: Shona Ghosh
title: Apple is investigating an iPhone X glitch which has stopped some people from answering calls (AAPL)
text: Apple is investigating an iPhone X glitch which has stopped some people from answering calls (AAPL) By Shona Ghosh Feb 5, 2018, 4:44 am 27 pts Apple is looking into reports of an iPhone X bug that makes it difficult for users to answer calls. Affected devices ring and vibrate with an incoming call, but take up to 10 seconds to show who's calling on the display. The bug means users can't swipe on the on-display button to answer calls.…
